div.head: IV Eg 9
div.ab: Gif hit þonne ofer fif niht ungecyd on gemænre læse wunað, þolige þæs orfes, swa we ǽr cwædon, ⁊ þara hyrda ælc þolige þære hyde; ⁊ þæs ne sy nán forgifnes, gesecen þæt hy gesecen; ⁊ he þeahhwæðere cyðe, on hwæs gewitnysse he þæt orf bohte.

Gif hit þonne ofer V niht ungecyd on gemænre læse wunað, þolige þæs orfes, swa we ær cwædon, ⁊ ðara hyrda ælc ðolige ðære hyde; ⁊ ðæs ne sy nan forgyfnes, gesecan þæt hi gesecan; ⁊ he ðeahhwæðere cyðe, on hwæs gewitnysse he þæt orf bohte.
Si uero alióquin noctibus quinque contigerit abscondi, sicut diximus, omne pecus perdat ad detrimendum et ignominiam sui; dirisque uerberum plagis pastores ipsos absque miseratione liceat affligi.

Gif hit þonne ofer V niht ungecyd on gemænre læse wunað, þolige þæs orfes swa we ær cwædon, ⁊ ðara hyrda ælc ðolige ðære hyde, ⁊ ðæs ne sy nan forgyfnes, gesecan þæt hi gesecan; ⁊ he ðeahhwæðere cyðe on hwæs gewitnysse he þæt orf bohte.

Wenn es jedoch über fünf Nächte ungemeldet auf Gemeinweide bleibt, verliere er, wie wir eben sagten, das Vieh, und jeder der Hirten verwirke die Haut [leide Prügelstrafe]; und für letzteres sei keine Erlassung, mögen sie [Zufluchtschutz] erreichen, welchen sie auch aufsuchen; und jener [Käufer] melde nichtsdestoweniger, unter wessen Zeugenschaft er das Vieh gekauft habe.

But if it remains unreported on the common pasture beyond five nights, let him lose the cattle, as we have just said, and let each of the herdsmen forfeit his hide [suffer a flogging]; and for the latter let there be no remission, whatever [sanctuary] they may seek; and let that [buyer] nevertheless report under whose witness he bought the cattle.

If, however, it remains unnotified on the common pasture for more than 5 days, he shall forfeit the livestock as we have stated, and each of the herdsmen shall undergo the lash, and there shall be no remission of that punishment, whatever refuge they seek; and the man himself shall declare none the less who was present as witness when he bought the livestock.

If, however, it remains on the common pasture more than five days unannounced, he is to forfeit the cattle, as we have said above, and each of the herdsmen is to be flogged; and there is to be no remission of that, no matter what refuge they reach; and he is nevertheless to declare in whose witness he bought that cattle.

note.seg: en illegible because of a stain
‘verborgen’ Versio ungenau. Unterlassen der Anzeige (s. d. Gl 11) macht strafbar
‘hidden’ Versio, inexactly. Failure to report (see that word in Gl 11) makes one liable to punishment
Sie sind unfrei (s. d. Gl 17k. 19. 23) laut der Prügel; s. d. Gl 2.—Die Haftung (s. d. Gl 13) wie die Missetat ist gemeinschaftlich; s. d. Gl 13c
They are unfree (see that word in Gl 17k. 19. 23), to judge by the flogging; see that word in Gl 2.—The liability (see that word in Gl 13), like the misdeed, is joint; see that word in Gl 13c
Diese Aufhebung des Asyls (s. d. Gl 13) lässt Versio fort, vielleicht in hierarchischer Absicht. Dieselben Redensarten o. 1, 5. III 7, 3.—Der letzte Satz wiederholt 7 Schluss

This suspension of the right of sanctuary (see that word in Gl 13) is omitted by the Versio, perhaps with hierarchical intent. The same phrases above 1, 5. III 7, 3.—The last sentence repeats the end of 7
Liebermann points out that these herdsmen are evidently slaves since freemen were not subjected to the lash.
